marketSummary: Indian equities extended their weekly recovery into the October 30 close, with the Nifty 50 reclaiming the 23,000 threshold to settle at 23,053.10 (+0.51%) and the Sensex advancing 308 points to 74,459.53. Momentum was underpinned by strong Q2 FY27 earnings beats from large-cap retail and defence heavyweights, alongside supportive institutional inflows after the US Federal Reserve held benchmark interest rates steady at 3.9%. While elevated crude oil prices remain an overhang, domestic institutional bids and select base breakouts across consumption, capital goods, and defence electronics continue to provide constructive setups for multi-day swing trades.
dailyFocus: Trade high-momentum earnings breakout continuation setups and stage-base pullbacks across Power Transmission, Defence PSUs, and Retail, keeping position sizing disciplined around key index support at 22,900.

news.headline: Nifty 50 Reclaims 23,000 Mark on Renewed FII Inflows and US Fed Status Quo
news.summary: The Nifty 50 rose 116 points to close at 23,053.10 on Friday, October 30, following two consecutive sessions of gains. Market sentiment was supported by FII turning net buyers (₹871 crore on October 28) and the Federal Reserve holding interest rates steady at 3.9%.
news.impact: Reclaiming the 23,000 psychological level improves the structural setup for swing longs across high relative-strength leaders.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Q2 Net Profit Jumps 20% YoY to ₹1,540 Crore, Order Book Reaches ₹68,717 Crore
news.summary: BEL reported consolidated Q2 FY27 results on October 30, with revenue rising 26.5% YoY to ₹7,328 crore and net profit increasing 20% YoY to ₹1,540 crore. EBITDA advanced 20% to ₹2,041 crore with an order book backlog of ₹68,717 crore alongside ₹1,011 crore in fresh October orders.
news.impact: Decisive earnings beat provides immediate fundamental tailwinds for continuation above its recent consolidation range.

news.headline: Trent Q2 Consolidated Net Profit Climbs 25% YoY to ₹468 Crore; Noel Tata to Retire as Chairman
news.summary: Trent delivered a 25% YoY jump in Q2 net profit to ₹468 crore on robust revenue expansion across Westside and Zudio formats. Concurrently, the board announced that Noel Tata will transition to Chairman Emeritus on November 12, with Bahram Vakil appointed Chairman effective November 11.
news.impact: Strong retail operating leverage triggered a 5-6% single-day breakout, validating trend continuation off key moving averages.

news.headline: Adani Ports Q2 Net Profit Advances 18% YoY to ₹3,682 Crore on Solid Cargo Momentum
news.summary: Adani Ports posted an 18% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹3,682.44 crore for the September quarter, propelled by record cargo handling volumes and logistics efficiency, sparking strong institutional demand.
news.impact: Heavy volume push off quarterly results positions the stock for a multi-session cup-and-handle breakout attempt.

news.headline: JSW Steel Q2 FY27 Net Profit Rises 14.1% YoY to ₹5,359 Crore Aided by Domestic Volumes
news.summary: JSW Steel reported a 14.1% YoY increase in consolidated net profit to ₹5,359 crore for Q2, backed by 6% domestic volume growth and firm infrastructure demand, offsetting softness in export realisations.
news.impact: Earnings stability near bottom of base sets up potential mean-reversion swings toward upper consolidation bounds.

news.headline: CG Power Q2 Net Profit Soars 44% YoY to ₹409 Crore; Approves EHV and GIS Capacity Expansion
news.summary: CG Power announced a 44% YoY surge in Q2 net profit to ₹409 crore as order intake climbed 78%, lifting the total order backlog to ₹23,646 crore. The board approved enhanced capex for the Vilholi GIS brownfield project to ₹44.62 crore and ₹15.31 crore for extra-high voltage circuit breaker lines.
news.impact: Robust order intake and capacity upgrades provide structural support for a base breakout attempt near multi-week resistance.

news.headline: IT Heavyweights Advance Over 1.5% as Global Rate Pause Relieves Valuation Multiples
news.summary: Nifty IT outpaced benchmark indices on October 30, led by gains in Infosys (+3.36%), Wipro (+4.32%), and HCL Tech (+1.72%), as institutional investors reallocated into large-cap exporters following the Fed's steady rate pause.
news.impact: Sector-wide volume surge confirms broad institutional accumulation for follow-through swing plays in leading software names.

news.headline: CG Power Affiliate Axiro Semiconductor Invests in ThinSiC for Next-Gen Silicon Carbide Power Tech
news.summary: CG Power announced via exchange filing on October 29 that Axiro Semiconductor made a strategic investment in ThinSiC to accelerate product design and foundry positioning for silicon carbide power semiconductor modules.
news.impact: Broadening into high-margin power semiconductor components adds valuation optionality to an already strong capital goods profile.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Wholly Owned Arm Bags Repeat Luxury River Cruise Vessels; Board Meet Due in November
news.summary: Subsidiary Hooghly-CSL secured a repeat contract to build two luxury river cruise vessels for Heritage River Journeys. Cochin Shipyard's total pipeline remains backed by international and domestic contracts, with the company closing its insider trading window ahead of upcoming Q2 financial results.
news.impact: Incremental order execution supports accumulation off the ₹1,100 support base ahead of quarterly results disclosure.

news.headline: French Defence Primes Expand Indian Procurement Past €1.2 Billion; HAL Koraput Line and Q2 Board Meeting in View
news.summary: French aerospace primes expanded sourcing beyond €1.2 billion, reinforcing joint turboshaft manufacturing with HAL for the Indian Multi-Role Helicopter, while HAL Koraput establishes a ₹218 crore Shakti engine facility. HAL's board will meet on November 12, 2026, to review Q2 financial results.
news.impact: Tight multi-week range below ₹4,900 offers a high-probability swing watchlist candidate ahead of the November 12 results catalyst.

news.headline: SBI Cards Q2 Net Profit Jumps 75% YoY to ₹778 Crore on Superior Asset Quality
news.summary: SBI Cards posted a 75% YoY climb in Q2 FY27 net profit to ₹778 crore as asset quality stabilized and cardholder spending accelerated ahead of peak festive cycles.
news.impact: Sharp earnings rebound provides strong breakout impetus out of an extended multimonth accumulation structure.
